 Examples:
 gaia search lkm knowledge "solid state battery dendrite suppression"
 gaia search lkm knowledge "unresolved battery failure" --scopes open_question
 What you have:
 a research question or claim text  ->  knowledge (this command)
 any global gcn_... / node id       ->  nodes
 a conclusion id with has_reasoning=true  ->  reasoning --claim-id
 a numeric paper ID from a hit      ->  package, references
 a local PDF                        ->  gaia extract
 Use this surface when you need LKM-grounded paper knowledge items: conclusion
 claims, weak-point / highlight claims, problems, and open questions from
 papers. Use --scopes question for all research questions, or problem,
 open_question, or subproblem for one question role.
 Use --scopes reasoning_chain to include complete chains in this fused search.
 `reasoning <query>` remains the dedicated search surface for reasoning chains
 and workflows.
 Empty --scopes defaults to conclusion claims plus abstracts. Use --scopes
 conclusion for conclusions only; use --scopes premise for premises. Response
 `kind` values such as highlight / weak_point are display labels, not search
 filters.
 --reasoning-only is a deprecated alias for --scopes conclusion. If a hit has a
 claim id, `reasoning --claim-id` can fetch that claim's supporting reasoning
 graph.
 Default search uses hybrid retrieval and comprehensive ranking. Add --keywords
 for lexical recall; use --sort-by recent or --sort-by journal when freshness
 or venue should dominate the first page.
 Use --scopes abstract for paper-level abstract hits. Treat abstracts as paper
 context, not Gaia claims; same-paper `related` hits are folded context, not
 cross-paper recommendations.
 API docs:
 https://s.apifox.cn/<UUID4>/api-459806352
 Endpoint links: gaia search lkm docs
 Note: `score` / `rerank_score` are retrieval ranking signals, not
 probabilities — do not pass to Gaia priors.
